statement: Clean fixed-seed rolling-restart runs at the July 24 pre-snapshot boundary, July 26 recovery-wiring boundary, July 29 pre-fix boundary, and current verified boundary classify whether the restarted-node transaction-recovery failure is a newly introduced regression or a pre-existing intermittent failure, with exact source provenance and no dirty-worktree reuse.

doneWhenSealed.commandContract: Each run executes rolling-restart with test/distributed/config/local-benchmark-7node.json, --deterministic-debug (seed 1337), --no-fast-local, --capture-logs, and a commit-labelled output from an otherwise clean detached worktree.
doneWhenSealed.samplingContract: Run one screening sample at every boundary. If a full-pass/failure-signature boundary appears, run two additional samples at each bracketing endpoint. If outcomes are mixed at an endpoint or the same restart-recovery signature exists before the suspected boundary, classify the behavior as pre-existing intermittent rather than a proved regression.
doneWhenSealed.failureSignature: A restarted node fails startup with TRANSACTION_RECOVERY_INCOMPLETE or becomes unreachable/recovery-unready with restart_recovery_timeout. Record other failures separately; they do not prove this regression.
doneWhenSealed.terminalBranches: REGRESSION_BOUNDARY requires the older endpoint to pass 3/3 and the newer endpoint to reproduce the sealed failure signature 3/3. PRE_EXISTING_INTERMITTENT requires the signature before the suspected boundary or mixed pass/fail outcomes at a boundary. INCONCLUSIVE requires invalid/non-measuring samples that prevent either classification.
doneWhenSealed.verdictArtifact: test-output/reports/rolling-restart-startup-recovery-regression-matrix.verdict.json with done=true, classification, exact commits, commands, report paths, per-run validity/verdict/signature, and the narrow next owner boundary.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Every matrix run must execute from a clean detached worktree at the exact declared commit, without fast-local data reuse, and record the commit plus command with its report.
Do not change timeout budgets or reinterpret an early failure as a pass; classify only the sealed transaction-recovery/restart-recovery signature.
Spend one screening run per boundary, then at most two confirmation runs per bracketing endpoint. Stop when the terminal branch is determined.
Before closure, ask an independent subagent to verify the exact commit provenance, report classification, and terminal-branch logic, then record its verdict as a Solver finding.
